items.observable: Validation and installation detected plugin.json from an unpacked directory without a format flag; status reported format=agent-plugin.
The closed 1.0.0 plugin schema was selected by its exact URI; future and client-owned schemas were rejected or classified outside the portable format.
Unknown top-level extension namespaces were ignored while owned fields retained closed validation and deterministic diagnostics.
Skills and MCP configuration were discovered only at the standard fixed locations under the package root.
The exact 1.0.0 MCP schema produced one stdio server and one streamable-http server; both were invoked through the daemon-hosted MCP projection.
PLUGIN_ROOT and PLUGIN_DATA expanded to absolute contained paths in args, environment values, and cwd; the provider wrote only beneath PLUGIN_DATA.
The stdio command stayed one executable token and defaulted cwd to the package root when cwd was omitted.
One installed generation exposed two skills and two MCP servers through extension inventory and real Claude Code and Hermes sessions.
